info.title: TakeMeHigh API
info.description: TakeMeHigh: operations system for one travel agency (single-tenant). Branches, staff and roles; countries, cities and categories; services, companies and supplier integrations; trips built from priced services, programs chaining trips, offers; customers with documents, bookings with passengers and live seats, visas, payments with PDF receipts; registration closing; statistics; the public landing page and custom trip requests. Requirement ids (e.g. TRP-05) refer to docs/srs/takemehigh. Sign in with POST /api/auth/login, then Authorize with the accessToken.
